description: Contrast (both-directions): RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2 mandates lowercase hexadecimal in \uXXXX escape sequences. An implementation that outputs \u001B (uppercase B) instead of \u001b (lowercase b) for U+001B produces a different pre-image and therefore a different digest. This vector pins both the conforming digest (jcs_n_correct_digest, same as jcs-n-kat-23) and the non-conforming digest (uppercase_contrast_digest) so that a test harness can assert the library produces the correct one and not the wrong one.
